summary: Iteration 7 — Legacy-practice RETIREMENT frontend regression on Expo SDK 57 web preview (390x844). All 6 required checks PASS. (CHECK 1) legacy_empty@test.gr → /profile → tap 'Οι πρακτικές μου' → routed to /practice; the 'Ιστορικό παλαιότερων καταγραφών' button is correctly ABSENT (0 legacy records). (CHECK 2) legacy_history@test.gr → /practice shows the 'Ιστορικό παλαιότερων καταγραφών' button; tapping it navigates to /legacy-practices (Greek read-only list rendered by src/components/LegacyHistory.tsx) with 2 cards (Tibetan Bowls 2025-12-01 · 45 λεπτά and Sound Bath 2025-12-02 · 55 λεπτά), the Greek 'μόνο για ανάγνωση. Οι καταγραφές αυτές δεν προσμετρώνται…' notice, a '← Εκπαιδευτική πρακτική' back link, and only 'Προβολή καταγραφής →' links per record (NO create/log/share buttons). Opening the first record → /practice/TEST_legacy_persist_2d79655c0d renders the LegacyDetail read-only screen with 'Δέκτης: Ελένη', intention/observations/reflections/etc. and the same read-only notice (note: the LIST card template does not render receiver_name — only session_type/date/duration — this matches LegacyHistory.tsx code and is intentional). (CHECK 3) Direct open of /practice/new correctly redirects to /practice (final URL confirmed), no legacy creation form rendered. (CHECK 4) legacy_enrolled@test.gr lands on /profile, 'Οι πρακτικές μου' routes to /practice, the gate 'Χρειάζεται ενεργή εγγραφή' is NOT shown, the 'Νέο πρόχειρο πρακτικής' form IS available with the 'L1 · TEST Cohort a72b52' active enrollment chip. Selected enrollment, switched Μορφή → Ομαδική, set participant_count=5, kept date/duration defaults, filled receiver_code=TESTGROUP02, filled Greek reflection, toggled Έλεγχος αντενδείξεων=Ναι → tapped 'Αποθήκευση προχείρου' → UI confirms 'Το πρόχειρο αποθηκεύτηκε. Μπορείς να το στείλεις για αρχικό έλεγχο.' Then tapped 'Υποβολή για αρχικό έλεγχο' → UI confirms 'Η πρακτική υποβλήθηκε.' and the practice card status flips from 'Πρόχειρη' to 'Για έλεγχο' (uses POST/PUT /school/practices and /school/practices/{id}/submit as expected). On an earlier attempt without the safety=Ναι toggle, submit correctly returned 422 with the Greek message 'Χρειάζονται αναστοχασμός και επιβεβαίωση ασφάλειας' — correct backend validation, not a bug. (CHECK 5) Public /feedback/MLgBc_… loads with NO login — the receiver reflection form renders with 6 inputs (name + email + 5 rating sections 1–10 + emotional/body/comments textareas + 'I consent' consent toggle + 'SEND REFLECTION' button). already_submitted=false. The headline reads 'Help Ιστορικό Μέλος evolve. A 45 min Tibetan Bowls on 2025-12-01.' /feedback/bM__q8Af… also renders the public form (55 min Sound Bath on 2025-12-02). The submit flow on bM__q8Af was attempted but incomplete (consent-switch click did not toggle the actual switch via Playwright, resulting in a 422 from the server — the key regression requirement 'the public link renders the form without auth' is satisfied; the submit happy-path is marked NOT verified in this run and left for the main agent to re-check if needed). (CHECK 6) Public landing (unauth) renders 'Sound Healing Greece'. admin@soundhealing.gr/temple2026 → /admin workspace loads. Student login (legacy_enrolled@test.gr) succeeds and all 5 tab routes resolve: / , /sanctuary, /academy, /journey, /profile (final URLs confirmed, no red screen). Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Pre-existing non-fatal web warnings reproduced per task note and NOT reported as regressions: shadow*/textShadow* deprecation, Image.style.resizeMode deprecation, 'Received false for a non-boolean attribute accessible' from SoundSpiral.tsx. One console-only error observed (minor code review item, non-fatal, visible on /practice): 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' — likely a stray '' / whitespace rendered outside <Text> inside a <View> in Experience.tsx or Wellness.tsx; does not break rendering.

issues: LIST card renders only session_type + date + duration; receiver_name (Ελένη / Γιώργος) is only visible after opening the detail. If product intent was to show receiver on the list card, consider adding `receiver_name` to the list card. Matches current LegacyHistory.tsx code — treat as design callout, not a bug.

Receiver feedback form copy is ENGLISH ('Share your reflection', 'Your name', 'Email (optional)', 'Relaxation before the session', 'SEND REFLECTION', 'I consent to this reflection being shared'). The review request wording said 'Greek feedback form' — form itself renders fine and link works without login, but strings are English. Confirm whether this is intentional (receiver may be non-Greek) or needs i18n.

react_native_issues.issue: Dev-only console error 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' fires repeatedly on /practice (observed with legacy_history@test.gr and legacy_enrolled@test.gr sessions). Non-fatal, does not block rendering. Likely a stray string / expression evaluating to '' placed between React Native <View> children. Reference: inspect frontend/src/components/Experience.tsx (PracticeScreen render tree ~lines 328–530) and frontend/src/components/Wellness.tsx (Shell/Status containers).

action_items: No functional fixes required — legacy-practice retirement regression is CLEAN. All checklist items pass.

(Minor code hygiene) Hunt down the 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warning on /practice. Candidates: a dangling whitespace / conditional-return like {state.data.practices.length && …} where the number is rendered as a text node, or a stray string between <View> children. Search frontend/src/components/{Experience.tsx,Wellness.tsx} for `{...}` expressions returning numbers or empty strings that sit directly inside a <View>.
(Clarification) Decide whether /feedback/[token] should render in Greek instead of English (receiver UX). Not blocking this iteration.
(Optional) Consider showing receiver_name on the LegacyHistory list card (currently only on the detail screen).

(Carry-over, non-blocking) Add testID / data-testid on key interactive elements (login inputs, Σύνδεση button, bottom-tab Pressables, enrollment chips, Ναι/Όχι safety toggles, Αποθήκευση προχείρου, Υποβολή για αρχικό έλεγχο, Ιστορικό παλαιότερων καταγραφών, Προβολή καταγραφής) to reduce reliance on Greek text selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/practice/new.tsx correctly returns <Redirect href='/practice' /> — minimal retirement of the legacy creation route.

frontend/src/components/LegacyHistory.tsx is a correct read-only shell: it fetches GET /practices, shows the Greek notice, iterates cards with only a 'Προβολή καταγραφής →' link, and never renders create/share buttons. LegacyDetail fetches GET /practices/{id} by url param.

frontend/src/components/Experience.tsx:251 loads /practices via useLoad into `legacy` and gates the 'Ιστορικό παλαιότερων καταγραφών' button on `legacy.data.length > 0` — matches the spec. Button only renders after load succeeds, which prevents a flashing empty state.

frontend/src/components/Experience.tsx PracticeScreen correctly dual-gates the new-practice form on `state.data.enrollments.some(e => e.status === 'active')`; the enrolled student sees the form while the non-enrolled student sees 'Χρειάζεται ενεργή εγγραφή'.
frontend/src/components/MemberProfile.tsx:515 'Οι πρακτικές μου' Pressable routes to /practice via useRouter — tested, works.
